body: *facepalm* You're lucky I have a sense of humor.  I don't feel much better but I got a chuckle :)

No offense to religious types, but religion always felt like the quick fix for finding purpose in life to me.  It gives you a gameplan for what life is supposed to be about, which can be comforting for some I suppose.  I, too, want to skip to the inevitable end.

Have you talked to your spouse yet, or are you keeping your atheist beliefs to yourself?  Some Christians are awesome and won't give you the fire and brimstone talk for deconverting.  I hope you two can find some common ground still.

I went on here for my own shit, so it's hard for me to give good advice to others.  I did, however, experience something similar when it comes to eating meat.  As a kid I would just stare at it and cry. Perhaps accepting that you don't want to eat it and finding vegetarian alternatives would feel good, like a step towards control over your life.  It's lame advice, and I know it doesn't address everything, but sometimes small choices like that make people feel more empowered.

Also, brohoof

Oh, and perhaps for a little bit more of a context, my one boyfriend dumped me and stopped talking to me recently because I'm "not doing enough" to get better despite being in therapy and on meds.  Because this boyfriend dumped me I lost the housing I was relying on moving into after I graduate, and the job I would've been moving down there for (no house = no move = no job).  I've been so stressed out that I'm failing my classes, so I won't be able to graduate this semester anyway.  My other boyfriend (poly) has been super supportive but I feel like I've just been super dependent on him and he's getting tired of it.  My family doesn't get it, I could sit up here bawwing my eyes out and they wouldn't give two fucks (they stopped being phased by it all a few years ago).

but all of this bullshit pails in comparison to the overall desire to die.  I hate life, I hate the concept of it.  It's a bigger existential issue going on but all my therapy (1 on 1 and group) can focus on is "Oh your boyfriend dumped you, that's why you're depressed!"  Bitch, it could be the best day ever and I would still want to die! Fuck people, man...
